headline: Why Is Medtronic (MDT) In The Spotlight After TIME Named Two Devices Best Inventions?
summary: Medtronic (NYSE:MDT) had its Stealth AXiS surgical system and Corsano wearable named to TIME Best Inventions of 2026. The recognition covers both an advanced surgical platform and a continuous cardiac monitoring wearable focused on patient care. TIME's list places Medtronic's two devices alongside a curated group of global consumer and enterprise technologies for 2026.
